notes.title: 1.0.3 Close Call, Swarmer Fix, and Typos
notes.content:
Added new achievement "Close Call" you earn by surviving a boss crashing into your turret, which is now possible since a bug where Bosses would stop advancing past a certain point has been patched.

Patched a bug where certain damage methods would cause Swarmers and Swarmlords to split into more enemies than intended. I also corrected some typos in certain attachment descriptions.

If you haven't already checked it out, the discord is a great place to report any bugs you find and share strategies: https://discord.gg/YrEvfp3Ak7
